panels.description: Vector House service corridor. Jalen watches white-and-amber nodes change state while holding his data case. Leave upper corridor space.
Jalen gives Alex a routing shard. Keep the shard and their hands clear; leave upper space.
Jalen's copper three-node access tag flashes a pattern-deviation review. Keep the tag unobstructed.
Jalen steps through the service door with Alex and the others. Keep the corridor behind him visible as the route he leaves; leave upper space.

items.speaker: JALEN
items.text: This keeps one failure from choking the whole unit.
